mechanics.name: Fogwise
mechanics.currentEffect: While repairing a Generator, succeeding a Great Skill Check reveals the Killer's Aura to you for 4/5/6 seconds.
activation: You must be repairing a Generator and succeed a Great Skill Check.
Ends/deactivates when: The Aura reveal ends after the tier's duration.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: A Great Skill Check while repairing briefly reveals the Killer's Aura to you.

editorial.summary: While repairing, each Great Skill Check reveals the Killer's Aura for several seconds.
useCases: Track the Killer while remaining productive on a generator.
Use repeated Great Skill Checks to decide whether to stay, hide, or rotate.
Pair with Skill Check support for more reliable Aura reads.
counters: Undetectable or Aura-blocking effects can deny reads.
No value while you are away from generators.
pros: Turns objective skill into Killer information.
Excellent synergy with Great Skill Check builds.
cons: Information can be redundant if the Killer is already visible.
analysis: Fogwise rewards accurate Great basic Skill Checks during Generator repair with repeated Killer Aura information, letting a productive Survivor decide whether to stay, hide, or rotate without leaving the objective.

The old Stake Out safety-net interaction no longer exists in live 10.2 because Stake Out special checks no longer activate other Skill Check perks. Hyperfocus can still share the same high-skill Generator shell, but it does not make Fogwise easier to trigger.
The main limitation is context. Fogwise does nothing during chase, rescue, or healing, and it is only as consistent as the user's ability to land Great basic Skill Checks.
That keeps it below universal information perks, while preserving a real niche for generator-focused players with strong Skill Check consistency.
editorial.verdict: A strong generator-information perk for players who can hit Greats consistently. Fogwise keeps you productive while answering the most important question: where is the Killer?
